parameters.query:
WITH user_data AS (
  SELECT 
    u.id,
    u.tg_id,
    u.tg_username,
    u.tg_first_name,
    u.tg_last_name,
    u.premium,
    u.language_code,
    u.created_at,
    u.referral_link,
    u.music_api_mode,
    u.is_bot_kicked,
    COALESCE(u.balance_wallet, 0) AS balance,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pocketsound_users WHERE referrer_id = u.tg_id) AS referrals_count
  FROM pocketsound_users u
  WHERE u.tg_id = {{ $json.tg_id }}
),
search_stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_searches
  FROM pocketsound_search_queries
  WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM user_data)
),
file_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_tracks_received,
    json_agg(json_build_object('artist', artist, 'count', cnt) ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS top_artists
  FROM (
    SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM pocketsound_files
    WHERE owner_user_id = (SELECT id FROM user_data)
    GROUP BY artist
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) t
),
playlist_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_playlists,
    COALESCE(SUM(pt.track_count), 0) AS total_tracks_in_playlists
  FROM pocketsound_playlists p
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT playlist_id, COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM pocketsound_playlist_tracks
    GROUP BY playlist_id
  ) pt ON pt.playlist_id = p.id
  WHERE p.user_id = (SELECT id FROM user_data)
),
upload_stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_uploaded_files
  FROM pocketsound_files
  WHERE owner_user_id = (SELECT id FROM user_data)
),
download_stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_deezer_downloads
  FROM pocketsound_download_queue
  WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM user_data)
    AND status = 'done'
),
share_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_shares_sent
  FROM pocketsound_file_shares
  WHERE from_user_id = (SELECT id FROM user_data)
)
SELECT 
  u.*,
  COALESCE(s.total_searches, 0) AS total_searches,
  COALESCE(f.total_tracks_received, 0) AS total_tracks_received,
  COALESCE(f.top_artists, '[]'::json) AS top_artists,
  COALESCE(ps.total_playlists, 0) AS total_playlists,
  COALESCE(ps.total_tracks_in_playlists, 0) AS total_tracks_in_playlists,
  COALESCE(us.total_uploaded_files, 0) AS total_uploaded_files,
  COALESCE(ds.total_deezer_downloads, 0) AS total_deezer_downloads,
  COALESCE(ss.total_shares_sent, 0) AS total_shares_sent
FROM user_data u
CROSS JOIN search_stats s
CROSS JOIN file_stats f
CROSS JOIN playlist_stats ps
CROSS JOIN upload_stats us
CROSS JOIN download_stats ds
CROSS JOIN share_stats ss;
